item.name: Ben's Ice Cream
item.description: A small Ice Cream shop located on the pier by the beach. Players can buy ice cream and work as a Seller.
item.cardSummary: A small Ice Cream shop located on the pier by the beach. Players can buy ice cream and work as a Seller.

item.name: Blox Burgers
item.description: A fast-food restaurant located in the town center. It serves burgers, drinks, and fries. Players can also work here as a Fast Food Worker.
item.cardSummary: A fast-food restaurant located in the town center. It serves burgers, drinks, and fries. Players can also work here as a Fast Food Worker.

item.name: Bloxburg Fresh Food
item.description: A supermarket located in the town center, next to the gym. Players can buy fruits, vegetables, drinks, and snacks to store in their refrigerator. They can work here as a Cashier or Stocker.
item.cardSummary: A supermarket located in the town center, next to the gym. Players can buy fruits, vegetables, drinks, and snacks to store in their refrigerator. They can work here as a Cashier or Stocker.

item.name: Bloxburg High School
item.description: A school located in the town center, behind the city hall. Players can attend classes to earn XP to level up their seniority, play musical instruments in the band, or roleplay in stage activities in the auditorium. They can also work at two jobs here, which are the Janitor and Teacher job.
item.cardSummary: A school located in the town center, behind the city hall. Players can attend classes to earn XP to level up their seniority, play musical instruments in the band, or roleplay in stage activities in the auditorium. They can also work at two jobs here, which are the Janitor and Teacher job.

item.name: Bloxburg Taxi
item.description: A transportation service located in the town center. Players can work here as a Taxi Driver.
item.cardSummary: A transportation service located in the town center. Players can work here as a Taxi Driver.

item.name: Lovely Lumber
item.description: A woodcutting service located near Peak Mountain. Players can work here as a Woodcutter.
item.cardSummary: A woodcutting service located near Peak Mountain. Players can work here as a Woodcutter.

item.name: Mike's Motors
item.description: A vehicle dealership located in the town center, near Bloxburg City Hall. Players can buy vehicles here and work as a Mechanic by walking to the side of the shop to repair motorbikes.
item.cardSummary: A vehicle dealership located in the town center, near Bloxburg City Hall. Players can buy vehicles here and work as a Mechanic by walking to the side of the shop to repair motorbikes.

item.name: Pizza Planet
item.description: A fast-food restaurant located in the town center, inspired by sci-fi movies, especially Toy Story. It is a popular place for players who are looking for a job or a hangout spot. Players can work here as a Pizza Baker or Delivery Person.
item.cardSummary: A fast-food restaurant located in the town center, inspired by sci-fi movies, especially Toy Story. It is a popular place for players who are looking for a job or a hangout spot. Players can work here as a Pizza Baker or Delivery Person.

item.name: Stylez Hair Studio
item.description: A hair salon located near the beach. Players can work here as a Hairdresser.
item.cardSummary: A hair salon located near the beach. Players can work here as a Hairdresser.

item.name: The Bloxburg Cave
item.description: A cave located in Peak Mountain. Players can work here as a Miner.
item.cardSummary: A cave located in Peak Mountain. Players can work here as a Miner.

item.name: The Fishing Hut
item.description: A small hut located on the pier, near Ben’s Ice Cream and the Ferris Wheel. Players can work here as a Fisherman.
item.cardSummary: A small hut located on the pier, near Ben’s Ice Cream and the Ferris Wheel. Players can work here as a Fisherman.

item.name: Bloxburg Theater
item.description: A movie theater, located in the town center, where players can watch community-made short films and purchase snacks.
item.cardSummary: A movie theater, located in the town center, where players can watch community-made short films and purchase snacks.

item.name: Bloxburg Town Hall
item.description: An aesthetic building in the town center. Currently, the building serves no gameplay purpose, but, it gives the town of Bloxburg a rather ravishing appearance.
item.cardSummary: An aesthetic building in the town center. Currently, the building serves no gameplay purpose, but, it gives the town of Bloxburg a rather ravishing appearance.

item.name: Bloxburg Gym
item.description: A gymnasium, located next to Bloxburg Fresh Food, where players can increase their Athletic skill.
item.cardSummary: A gymnasium, located next to Bloxburg Fresh Food, where players can increase their Athletic skill.

item.name: Fancy Furniture
item.description: A furniture store, located in the town center, where players can buy Build Mode furniture.
item.cardSummary: A furniture store, located in the town center, where players can buy Build Mode furniture.

item.name: Beach
item.description: A sandy beach, with a pier on which there is a Ferris Wheel, Ben's Ice Cream, and the Fishing Hut. Here, players can relax in lounge chairs or cabanas, build sandcastles, use the showers to increase their hygiene, or take a swim in the ocean.
item.cardSummary: A sandy beach, with a pier on which there is a Ferris Wheel, Ben's Ice Cream, and the Fishing Hut. Here, players can relax in lounge chairs or cabanas, build sandcastles, use the showers to increase their hygiene, or take a swim in the ocean.

item.name: Bloxburg Pier
item.description: A wooden boardwalk that extends over the beach and overlooks the ocean. Here, players can ride the Ferris Wheel and Carousel, play the Strength Test activity, purchase food and Build Mode items, or relax at the picnic tables along the waterfront.
item.cardSummary: A wooden boardwalk that extends over the beach and overlooks the ocean. Here, players can ride the Ferris Wheel and Carousel, play the Strength Test activity, purchase food and Build Mode items, or relax at the picnic tables along the waterfront.

item.name: Ferris Wheel
item.description: An attraction located on the Bloxburg Pier at the beach. Here, players can use relax, watch the sky, and roleplay. Riding on it also increases the Fun and Energy moods.
item.cardSummary: An attraction located on the Bloxburg Pier at the beach. Here, players can use relax, watch the sky, and roleplay. Riding on it also increases the Fun and Energy moods.

item.name: Carousel
item.description: An attraction located on the Bloxburg Pier at the beach. Players can ride it for approximately 20 seconds before it stops and must be interacted with again.
item.cardSummary: An attraction located on the Bloxburg Pier at the beach. Players can ride it for approximately 20 seconds before it stops and must be interacted with again.

item.name: Gazblox
item.description: A gas station with a convenience store, located in the town center, where players can buy and stock up on snacks and drinks here.
item.cardSummary: A gas station with a convenience store, located in the town center, where players can buy and stock up on snacks and drinks here.

item.name: Fiona's Flowers
item.description: A flower shop, located in the town center, where players can purchase all sorts of flowers.
item.cardSummary: A flower shop, located in the town center, where players can purchase all sorts of flowers.

item.name: Snug as a Bug
item.description: A baby store, located in the town center, where players can purchase all sorts of baby-themed items and furniture.
item.cardSummary: A baby store, located in the town center, where players can purchase all sorts of baby-themed items and furniture.

item.name: Soak-n-Suds
item.description: A laundromat, located in the town center, where players can wash and dry clothes in the many washers and dryers that it provides.
item.cardSummary: A laundromat, located in the town center, where players can wash and dry clothes in the many washers and dryers that it provides.

item.name: Tombelina's Dance Studio
item.description: A dance studio, located in the town center, where players can practice ballet routines to increase their Athletic skill and participate in dance-themed roleplays.
item.cardSummary: A dance studio, located in the town center, where players can practice ballet routines to increase their Athletic skill and participate in dance-themed roleplays.

item.name: Observatory
item.description: An observatory, located on Peak Mountain, where players can relax, view the city, look at the different constellations, and wonder about space and the distant cosmos.
item.cardSummary: An observatory, located on Peak Mountain, where players can relax, view the city, look at the different constellations, and wonder about space and the distant cosmos.

item.name: Riverside Park
item.description: A large recreation area located near Riverside Estates, hence its name. It is a large public park that has a playground and picnic area, also serving as a music and entertainment venue.
item.cardSummary: A large recreation area located near Riverside Estates, hence its name. It is a large public park that has a playground and picnic area, also serving as a music and entertainment venue.

item.name: Bloxy Acres Pool
item.description: A large community pool located near Bloxy Acres, hence its name.
item.cardSummary: A large community pool located near Bloxy Acres, hence its name.

item.name: Peak Camp
item.description: A large campground that is located on Peak Mountain. Players can roast some marshmallows at the campfire, and sleep in one of the many tents.
item.cardSummary: A large campground that is located on Peak Mountain. Players can roast some marshmallows at the campfire, and sleep in one of the many tents.

item.name: Meh-Meh Camp
item.description: A small campsite that is located on the banks of the lake, near Lovely Lumber and Peak Mountain. Players can roast some marshmallows at the campfire, sleep in the tents, or relax on the beach.
item.cardSummary: A small campsite that is located on the banks of the lake, near Lovely Lumber and Peak Mountain. Players can roast some marshmallows at the campfire, sleep in the tents, or relax on the beach.

item.name: Lighthouse
item.description: An aesthetic structure located on Cape Beacon, which is near the Innerloop Highway and Riverside Estates.
item.cardSummary: An aesthetic structure located on Cape Beacon, which is near the Innerloop Highway and Riverside Estates.

item.name: Water Tower
item.description: An aesthetic structure located on top of a hill in the Bloxy Acres neighborhood.
item.cardSummary: An aesthetic structure located on top of a hill in the Bloxy Acres neighborhood.

item.name: The Tunnels
item.description: Two transit passageways in the city of Bloxburg. The Cliffside Tunnel is located on Innerloop Highway, while the Pinewood Bypass tunnel is located on Mountain Road.
item.cardSummary: Two transit passageways in the city of Bloxburg. The Cliffside Tunnel is located on Innerloop Highway, while the Pinewood Bypass tunnel is located on Mountain Road.

item.name: Wind Turbines
item.description: Five wind turbines located at the outskirts of Bloxburg. Three are near the Neighborhoods Tunnel, while two are in Greenfield Plains.
item.cardSummary: Five wind turbines located at the outskirts of Bloxburg. Three are near the Neighborhoods Tunnel, while two are in Greenfield Plains.

item.name: Telecom. Masts
item.description: Two telecommunications masts located in different regions of Bloxburg. One is near Riverside Estates, while the other is in Greenfield Plains.
item.cardSummary: Two telecommunications masts located in different regions of Bloxburg. One is near Riverside Estates, while the other is in Greenfield Plains.

item.cardSummary: The player's houses/plot.

item.cardSummary: A river that players can swim within.

item.cardSummary: A small waterfall located in Peak Mountain

item.name: Meh-Meh Lake
item.description: A large body of water near Lakeview Heights sourced by the Meh-Meh Falls, and surrounded by the Peak Mountain and the Bloxburg Dam.
item.cardSummary: A large body of water near Lakeview Heights sourced by the Meh-Meh Falls, and surrounded by the Peak Mountain and the Bloxburg Dam.

item.name: The Island
item.description: A small island located far out in the ocean. Players can find the Giant Seashell near the island’s rocky shores and receive a trophy for finding it.
